item.title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.

item.tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

answer_sheet.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
answer_sheet.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

must_haves: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Square logo for a bakery called Mooncrumb. Minimal elegant vector-style brand mark: a refined gold crescent moon centered above the exact word "Mooncrumb" in dark navy lettering, beautifully crafted readable serif typography, warm artisanal bakery feel. Gold #D4AF37, dark navy #101E38. Centered balanced composition with generous empty margin, crescent clearly separate above lettering. Only the crescent and the word Mooncrumb; no other text, no border, no shadows, no gradients, no mockup, no texture. Flat crisp graphic on a completely plain solid white background for subsequent background removal. All logo elements solid opaque colors; preserve the open crescent shape.
